title: EE60031: Industrial Instrumentation
text:
Syllabus
Syllabus mentioned in ERP

Static and dynamic characteristics of sensors, Resistive, Inductive and
Capacitive sensors and signal conditioning circuits. Temperature, pressure,
flow and level measurement techniques. pH and conductivity sensors. Piezoelectric and ultrasonic sensors and its application in process and biomedical
Instrumentation. Measurement of viscosity, humidity and thermal conductivity.
Optical Instrumentation: devices, intensity modulation and interferometric
technique. Nucleonic gauges: Sources and Detectors and its application.
Interfacing Sensors and actuators using LabVIEW programs. Instrumentation
system Design.
